The '''Force Assassins''' were a band of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] that operated in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], they were locked in a war with the [[Warren Assault Squad]],<ref name="SWG:EE" /> an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] splinter faction led by traitorous Imperial [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Bors Teraud]].<ref name="SWG:P3">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|Publish 3}}</ref> Nobody but the Force Assassins themselves and their enemy was aware of why they originally began to fight; and why they still continued to war against each other. Strangely, the Empire turned a blind eye to the conflict. The war between the Force Assassins and the Warren Assault Squad focused on area of the Dantooine system known as the [[Ebon Essentia]].<ref name="SWG:EE" /> In space, the Force Assassins flew [[M3-A Scyk interceptor/Legends|M3-A Scyk fighters]] and [[M12-L Kimogila heavy fighter]]s.<ref name="SWG:DS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Force Assassins appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Force Assassins were added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:DS" />
